test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A financial institution claims that it returns three times the principal in 25 years on a certain rate of simple interest per annum. What is the rate of simple interest?
solution: Given: Returns 3 times the principal in 25 years . Formula used: Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]
